# This file lists the species the conservation view compares human genes
# against, one row per species. You can edit the set freely: add or remove
# rows, but keep the homo_sapiens row. Each row has five columns, which are
#   ensembl_name    is the species' production name at Ensembl, written in
#                   lowercase with underscores. Orthologs are looked up by it,
#                   so it has to match Ensembl exactly.
#   display_name    is the label the atlas shows for the species.
#   taxon_id        is the species' NCBI Taxonomy id, which the build carries
#   timetree_name   is the species' name at TimeTree. It is only used with
#   ucsc_name       is the assembly name at UCSC. It is only used with
# Blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored.
